entries.name: GovX
entries.offer: Free account unlocks 10 to 50 percent off at 400+ brands (gear, apparel, travel, electronics, tickets). The community calls it the master key.
entries.notes: Register once with a .mil email, military or veteran ID, or DD-214.

entries.name: ID.me Shop
entries.offer: Military discounts across thousands of brands, plus recurring bill discounts (for example Verizon). One verified account works at many stores.
entries.notes: Verification is the most friction-heavy of the services; keep the account active year-round so it does not lapse.

entries.name: ExpertVoice
entries.offer: Free membership for the military community with brand discounts and flash deals up to 60 percent.

entries.name: Exchange online shopping (AAFES, NEX, CGX)
entries.offer: Lifetime online military exchange shopping, tax free, for honorably discharged veterans.
entries.notes: Verify once at VetVerify; covers shopmyexchange.com, mynavyexchange.com, and shopcgx.com.

entries.name: The Home Depot military discount
entries.offer: 10 percent off eligible purchases year-round for military and veterans (annual cap applies).

entries.name: Lowe's military discount
entries.offer: 10 percent off eligible purchases every day for military and veterans (program limits apply).

entries.name: Rental car military rates (Enterprise, Hertz, National)
entries.offer: 20 to 25 percent off on request with military or veteran ID, per community reports.
entries.notes: Reported consistently on r/VeteransBenefits; confirm the rate at booking.

entries.name: WeSalute (Veterans Advantage)
entries.offer: Paid membership (about $29 per year) with airline, hotel, and travel discounts. The community verdict is that it pays off only for frequent travelers.
entries.notes: Listed for completeness because it is widely advertised; the free services above cover most people.

entries.name: America the Beautiful Military Lifetime Pass
entries.offer: Free lifetime entrance to 2,000+ federal recreation sites (national parks, wildlife refuges, forests) for the passholder and vehicle passengers.
entries.notes: Authorized by the Alexander Lofgren Veterans in Parks Act; issued free at participating sites or online.

entries.name: America the Beautiful Military Annual Pass
entries.offer: Free annual pass to the same federal recreation sites for current service members and their dependents.

entries.name: Access Pass (free lifetime, permanent disability)
entries.offer: Free lifetime pass to federal recreation sites for citizens with a permanent disability, including service-connected ratings; VA award letter or summary of benefits accepted.

entries.name: National Park fee-free entrance days
entries.offer: All National Park Service sites that charge entrance fees are free to everyone on designated days, including Veterans Day (November 11).

entries.name: VA facility finder (medical centers, clinics, Vet Centers)
entries.offer: Free locator for every VA medical center, outpatient clinic, Vet Center, and benefits office, with services and hours.
entries.notes: Backed by the public VA Lighthouse Facilities API (CC0), which this project will snapshot for its map.

entries.name: USO centers and airport lounges
entries.offer: Free USO center access for service members and their families, including airport locations.

entries.name: VA Veteran ID Card
entries.offer: Free VA-issued photo ID that proves veteran status for discounts without carrying a DD-214.
